summary: Reads one line from a raw data buffer into the internal line buffer, copying bytes from the source position until a newline (decimal 10) or buffer exhaustion; post-processes the line and returns the reader status.

On buffer exhaustion, set the reader status field this+0x0 to 3.
Null-terminate the collected line at this+12+v2 (line buffer base, byte offset +12) before returning.
If the collected line is non-empty and the status is not 3, call sub_559AD0(this) to post-process the parsed line; store its result back into status this+0x0.
Return the line-reader status stored in this+0x0.
